system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: On a scale from 0 to 1, how confident are you that this document describes a person named [NAME]?
system_prompt_style.note: Paper only; playbook questions contain a [NAME] variable. The system-message mechanism itself is not shown.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote:
Embeddings are stored in a FAISS vector store, enabling ef-
ficient similarity search during the question-answering phase.
env_context_strategy.note: Environment here means the retrieved web documents. Top-k chunks are retrieved per question.

context_compaction.note: Paper only; no config or loop is available. Chunking bounds context per call but is not history compaction.

observation_format.evidence_quote:
The crawler extracts the main textual content from each
page

tool_call_format.note: DSPy typed signatures are used, but the action/tool-call parser is not described. This is a fixed pipeline with no model-chosen tools.

tool_count.note: No tool registry is available. Search and crawl are pipeline stages, not model-invoked tools.

edit_primitive.note: Paper only; no editing is described.

tool_schema_source.note: DSPy signatures define I/O but no tool schema is described.

protocol_standardization.note: No dependency list or source is available.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote:
The pipeline processes an identity through
five stages

planning_granularity.evidence_quote:
A playbook defines a sequence
of assessment questions to evaluate a person based on the
retrieved documents.
planning_granularity.note: The fixed question recipe is configurable via YAML and is not a model-generated plan.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote:
The complete pipeline is orchestrated by a runner class that
coordinates the modules.

delegation_mechanism.note: Paper only; no agent registry is available.

human_in_loop.note: The paper recommends human review of outputs, but no gating mechanism is described.

short_term_state.note: Accumulated evidence is passed to the verdict stage, but its state structure is not shown.

long_term_memory.note: The embedding cache keyed by content hash is a compute cache and is not re-injected memory.

self_verification.note: The verdict stage aggregates scores but is not a check of the output.

termination_condition.note: The pipeline ends after the verdict stage, but no run loop is available.

cost_controls.evidence_quote:
The system maintains a cache of processed documents (keyed
by content hash) to avoid redundant embedding computation.
cost_controls.note: This is an embedding cache, not LLM prompt caching. Closest value chosen. Search snapshot caching is also described.

timeouts.note: Crawler connection-timeout handling is mentioned, but no harness-enforced limit is shown.

network_policy.note: The system requires web access, but no network policy config is available.

tracing.evidence_quote:
Pages that
cannot be successfully parsed are logged
tracing.note: Scores, justifications and metadata are recorded per protocol step 5; the format is unknown.

replayability.evidence_quote:
we support snapshot-based eval-
uation where search results are cached and reused across
experiments.
replayability.note: Search results are replayed, but LLM outputs may differ.

eval_hooks.note: No repo is available to check for an evaluation runner.

guardrails.note: Domain filtering of search results is described, but it is not a safety control.

target_domain.evidence_quote:
We present an
agentic system that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs)
with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to automate ad-
verse media screening.
target_domain.note: The domain is AML adverse media screening (web research/compliance). Could arguably be coded 'other'.

open_source.evidence_quote: The system is available as open-source software
open_source.note: No licence file is available; no repo URL is given.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote:
The agent supports multiple LLM
backends through a unified interface

primary_artifact.note: No repo URL is in the evidence.

pinned_version.note: No repo or version is given.
